description: Summarize content from a given URL
inlineCode: async function summarize_webpage({ url, maxLength = 200 }) { try { const response = await fetch(url); const html = await response.text(); const textContent = html.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const words = textContent.split(' '); const summary = words.slice(0, maxLength).join(' '); return { success: true, summary, originalLength: words.length, summaryLength: summary.split(' ').length, url }; } catch (error) { return { success: false, error: error.message, url }; } }
